episodes.synopsis: Mr. Roarson invites his teacher, Master Gigi, to Challenge Island to celebrate Halloween, but unfortunately the turtle can't find his way around. Will they meet in time before the day is out?
episodes.title: Hello, Halloween!

episodes.synopsis: Walking with Shimajiro across the island to see what costumes his friends are wearing for Halloween, Tamasaburo can't decide what to wear, as he doesn't want to be the same thing as anyone else. What will he dress up as?
episodes.title: Dressing up for Halloween
